name: GEVS Level 3b — goal planner (spatial layer 3b)
description: planner-desk-work: setGoal desk.work from across the room (spawn 0,0.15 — the desk's resolved standing point sits at ≈(-2.83, -0.35)) → the planner turns, walks, arrives within tolerance of the spot, faces the desk, and plays the manifest work prompt. Evidence comes from the planner telemetry merged into window.__ardy.getTelemetry().planner (goal/phase/distanceToSpot/facingErrDeg/replans/promptLog) sampled at 2 Hz plus the per-frame root probe (position trace). Assertions: arrival measured at the first 'interact'/'done' phase sample (the moment the interaction prompt fired); facing error at the same sample; the interaction prompt observed in the planner prompt log; no watchdog gate trips; no stream resets beyond the expected prompt transitions (streamResets counts residual-clamp resets only, so prompt sends do not count); at most one path replan; stream stays live. Thresholds calibrated from the first live run of 2026-08-02 (see 'basis' notes); the spec pins ARRIVE_TOLERANCE_M 0.35 and one-replan-then-fail.

assertions.basis: planner must reach the interact/done phase (telemetry phase at the first interact sample)
spec ARRIVE_TOLERANCE_M 0.35 against the RESOLVED standing point, +0.1 m 2 Hz sampling slack
spec TURN_TOLERANCE_DEG 20 + slack; manifest facingDeg -90 (faces the desk)
the manifest work prompt ('a person sits at a desk working') must appear in the planner prompt log
spec: one replan then fail with reason; a clean run should use 0
no drift-watchdog gate trips during the goal
no residual-clamp stream resets beyond the expected prompt transitions (a single stochastic teleport, observed 1 in ~50 check-windows, recovers via the T2 crossfade → partial)
